bindings.absent_bindings_reason: This pilot proves a relation between two handwritten alphabets. No component, lowering helper or engine instance is a subject of these theorems, so binding one would imply a correspondence this package does not establish. WIT-TRACE-06 stays open until the correspondence route has one.

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_projection

theorems.statement: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_projection : ∀ (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), List.filterMap RegionTrace.projectStep (RegionTrace.erase steps) = List.filterMap RegionTrace.projectStep steps

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_decisions

theorems.statement: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_decisions : ∀ (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), RegionTrace.decisions (RegionTrace.erase steps) = RegionTrace.decisions steps

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_commit_identities

theorems.statement: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_commit_identities : ∀ (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), RegionTrace.commitIdentities (RegionTrace.erase steps) = RegionTrace.commitIdentities steps

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_read_crossings

theorems.statement: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_read_crossings : ∀ (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), RegionTrace.readCrossings (RegionTrace.erase steps) = RegionTrace.readCrossings steps

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_release_members

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_read_commits

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_well_formedness

theorems.name: RegionTrace.retainFrom_complete
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: a budget that affords the whole trace cuts nothing
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.retainFrom_complete : ∀ (fuel : Nat) (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), RegionTrace.traceCost steps ≤ fuel → RegionTrace.retainFrom fuel steps = steps

theorems.name: RegionTrace.retainFrom_fuel_stable
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: the budgeted semantics is fuel stable (Langlib halted_stable)
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.retainFrom_fuel_stable : RegionTrace.FuelStable RegionTrace.retainFrom

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_stable_under_more_fuel
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: a relation that holds at a completing budget holds at every larger budget
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_stable_under_more_fuel : ∀ (source : List RegionTrace.SourceEvent) (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep) (fuel more : Nat), RegionTrace.traceCost steps ≤ fuel → fuel ≤ more → RegionTrace.related source (RegionTrace.retainFrom fuel steps) = true → RegionTrace.related source (RegionTrace.retainFrom more steps) = true

theorems.name: RegionTrace.magic_fuel_relates_only_at_one_budget
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04 control: a semantics right at one fuel value only relates there and not one unit later
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.magic_fuel_relates_only_at_one_budget : RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 7] (RegionTrace.magicFuelRetain 3 RegionTrace.releasedReadTarget) = true ∧ RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 8, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit RegionTrace.CommitKind.guestRelease 7] (RegionTrace.magicFuelRetain 4 RegionTrace.releasedReadTarget) = false

theorems.name: RegionTrace.magic_fuel_is_not_fuel_stable
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04 control: fuel stability refuses the one-fuel-value semantics
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.magic_fuel_is_not_fuel_stable : ¬RegionTrace.FuelStable RegionTrace.magicFuelRetain

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_omitted_unused_read
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02 control: a trace omitting a protected read whose value is unused is refused although its final answer agrees
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_rejects_omitted_unused_read : RegionTrace.finalResponse (RegionTrace.lower RegionTrace.observedReleaseWithoutRead) = RegionTrace.finalResponse (RegionTrace.lower RegionTrace.observedReadAndRelease) ∧ RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 1, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit (RegionTrace.CommitKind.regionRead 0 1) 2, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.resp RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead (some 1) none, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.guestRelease 0 0, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.resp RegionTrace.Operation.guestRelease none none] (RegionTrace.lower RegionTrace.observedReleaseWithoutRead) = false

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_source_reads_are_target_reads
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: a related source trace claims exactly the target read crossings, in order
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_source_reads_are_target_reads : ∀ (source : List RegionTrace.SourceEvent) (target : List RegionTrace.AbiStep), RegionTrace.related source target = true → RegionTrace.sourceReads source = RegionTrace.readCrossings target

theorems.name: RegionTrace.abnormal_exit_keeps_commits
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: an abnormal exit projects to nothing, so a trap cannot remove an earlier commit
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.abnormal_exit_keeps_commits : ∀ (steps : List RegionTrace.AbiStep) (exitClass : RegionTrace.ExitClass), List.filterMap RegionTrace.projectStep (steps ++ [RegionTrace.AbiStep.abnormalExit exitClass]) = List.filterMap RegionTrace.projectStep steps

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_trap_that_drops_a_commit
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04 control: a source trace dropping a commit made before a trap is refused; keeping it relates
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_rejects_trap_that_drops_a_commit : RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 1] RegionTrace.trappedAfterCommit = false ∧ RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 1, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit (RegionTrace.CommitKind.regionRead 0 1) 2] RegionTrace.trappedAfterCommit = true

theorems.name: RegionTrace.lower_correct_on_every_input
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05: the lowering relates every read-and-release input (identity, region, value)
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.lower_correct_on_every_input : RegionTrace.CorrectOnEveryInput RegionTrace.lower

theorems.name: RegionTrace.empty_only_lowering_matches_on_the_empty_input
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 control: a lowering right only on the empty input agrees with the model there
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.empty_only_lowering_matches_on_the_empty_input : RegionTrace.lowerEmptyOnly [] = RegionTrace.lower [] ∧ RegionTrace.related [] (RegionTrace.lowerEmptyOnly []) = true

theorems.name: RegionTrace.empty_only_lowering_is_not_correct_on_every_input
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 control: the universally quantified statement refuses the empty-input-only lowering
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.empty_only_lowering_is_not_correct_on_every_input : ¬RegionTrace.CorrectOnEveryInput RegionTrace.lowerEmptyOnly

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_swapped_requests
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 control: a swapped request order is refused
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_rejects_swapped_requests : RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.guestRelease 0 0, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.resp RegionTrace.Operation.guestRelease none none, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 1, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit (RegionTrace.CommitKind.regionRead 0 1) 2, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.resp RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead (some 1) none] (RegionTrace.lower RegionTrace.observedReadAndRelease) = false

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_substituted_response_value
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 control: a substituted response value is refused
theorems.statement: RegionTrace.related_rejects_substituted_response_value : RegionTrace.related [RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead 0 1, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.commit (RegionTrace.CommitKind.regionRead 0 1) 2, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.resp RegionTrace.Operation.regionRead (some 2) none, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.req RegionTrace.Operation.guestRelease 0 0, RegionTrace.SourceEvent.resp RegionTrace.Operation.guestRelease none none] (RegionTrace.lower RegionTrace.observedReadAndRelease) = false

scope: .cairn/changes/region-trace-relation WIT-TRACE-01 model: source alphabet, target ABI alphabet and the relation.
The target alphabet is a handwritten machine. No emitted ABI step correspondence, no Wasmtime/Canonical ABI claim,
no Rust host or lowering claim, and no liveness claim. The host records its own ordered trace with
the exact retained identity, and pairing is stated over projected source traces rather than proved
for the emitted component own steps; the observed-trace lowering maps an observation, not a
